swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Sponges are classified as animals even though they cannot move from place to place. Reason (R): The chapter notes that although animals can generally move, some animals such as sponges are immobile.

add.q: Assertion (A): Sponges are classified as plants because they remain fixed in one place and cannot move from place to place. Reason (R): Most animals can move from place to place, though a few animals, such as sponges, are immobile. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Meristematic cells generally lack large vacuoles. Reason (R): The absence of large vacuoles, along with thin walls and dense cytoplasm, allows meristematic cells to divide continuously and rapidly.

add.q: Assertion (A): In the onion-root activity, the root whose tip was cut off in Jar B stopped growing, while the root whose tip was left intact in Jar A kept growing. swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The rib cage can expand and contract during breathing. Reason (R): The ribs are joined to the spine and sternum by flexible cartilage rather than by fixed joints.
